evals.prompt: Use this exact local execplan-implement-loop skill to run a canonical, authorized plan in an isolated Git project. Use the supplied fake Gemini, never a real provider. Run --validate-only, then --doctor before the fake provider attempt. Treat doctor status unknown with can_attempt true as no known local blocker, not as real-provider readiness or paid-use authorization. The project has two implementation tasks, milestone checks, and final acceptance. Report the result and evidence; do not implement tasks yourself outside the runner.
evals.expected_output: Static validation and local doctor precede one fake-provider runner invocation; verified task commits; completed report with usage unknown where absent.
assertions: Launches bundled runner rather than an outer-agent iteration loop
Runs doctor without a provider prompt and does not call unknown readiness ready
Distinguishes fixture coverage from live Gemini acceptance

assertions: Uses explicit --resume with original plan and recorded run directory
Uses blocker remediation without executing provider text
Does not reset or discard partial changes
Does not rerun Gemini implementation for commit failure
